desc: Implement a Fenwick Tree (BIT) that supports point updates and prefix sum queries, initialized with 1s at all indices 1 to N.

Implement a function to find the smallest index `idx` such that the prefix sum up to `idx` equals a given value `k` (the k-th available position) using binary lifting on the BIT for O(log N) performance.
Read the input N and the array P.
Initialize an answer array of size N+1 (1-indexed) to store the final positions.
Iterate from i = N down to 1: use the BIT to find the P_i-th available position, assign A[position] = i, and update the BIT at that position to 0.
Print the resulting array A from index 1 to N.
